workload_work_year_days_001.evidence: ■ The work year for classroom teachers, speech pathologists, occupational therapists, and physical therapists assigned to the Montgomery County Infants and Toddlers Program (MCITP) shall not exceed 215 duty days.

workload_workday_length_002.answer: 7 hours + lunch (school-based 10-month); 8 hours + lunch (central/field/12-month). Specific clock times are not stated, only that assignments ensure this length.
workload_workday_length_002.evidence: normal workday at their school will be seven hours in addition to their duty-free lunch period. All 12-month personnel... will be assigned appropriate starting and dismissal times so that their normal workday will be eight hours in addition to their lunch period.

workload_prep_guarantee_003.evidence: requirement to provide a minimum of 3 hours and 45 minutes for individually managed planning and work.

workload_prep_minutes_004.answer: Elementary: minimum 3 hours 45 minutes individually managed per regular workweek. Secondary: minimum 50 percent of total non-instructional time during student day individually managed.
workload_prep_minutes_004.evidence: teacher schedules will include a minimum of 3 hours and 45 minutes of time that is for individually managed planning and work during regular workweeks. ... provide for a minimum of 50 percent of the total non-instructional time during the student day to be individually managed.

workload_prep_protected_005.evidence: Parameters must take into account the other duties assigned to teachers and the requirement to provide a minimum of 3 hours and 45 minutes for individually managed planning and work. ... not at times that result in loss of guaranteed minimum individually managed time.

workload_lunch_duty_free_006.evidence: duty-free lunch period. Unit members’ lunch period shall be no less than 30 minutes in length.
